# ui::GradientStops

Header: `winui/render/Brush.hpp`.

The stops of a gradient brush, in order: a list kept inside the brush up to four stops, so handing a theme's gradient to a control or a renderer allocates nothing. More stops go to the heap. Built like a vector, from a braced list or from a [`std::vector<GradientStop>`](gradient-stop.md), and read like one.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::GradientStops stops{{0.0f, ui::colors::White}, {1.0f, ui::colors::Black}};
stops.push_back({0.5f, ui::Color::from_rgba(128, 128, 128)});
for (const ui::GradientStop& stop : stops) { (void)stop.offset; }
```
